draft.subject: Next step for your Clearwater Analytics workspace
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge last week -- that ticket is closed on our side, so do say if it's still showing up for you.

Your first project is up, which is the main thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it would help, I'm happy to walk through getting your team's real work in there on a short call this week -- 15 minutes, whenever suits you.

Best,
Nadia
